changelog:
Huawei Cloud CCI Instance Management skill — initial release.

- Provides full lifecycle management of CCI resources (Namespace, Network, Deployment, StatefulSet, Pod, EIPPool) via hcloud CLI.
- Enforces two-step confirmation for all destructive operations to prevent accidental data loss.
- Requires namespace flavor annotation; enforces resource limits equal to requests; validates correct workflow order (Network before workloads).
- Provides strict security: never outputs credentials; validation via `hcloud configure list` only.
- Explains CLI workarounds (Python helper script for Network creation) and credential separation.
- Includes comprehensive documentation of constraints, workflows, and security rules.
summary: Huawei Cloud CCI (Cloud Container Instance) full lifecycle management using hcloud CLI. Covers Namespace, Network, Deployment, StatefulSet, Pod creation/update/delete/status, EIPPool for public IP, logs and metrics. Two-step confirmation for all destructive operations (delete namespace cascades all resources under it). Use this skill when the user wants to operate CCI serverless containers via command line. Triggers: CCI, 云容器实例, serverless container, 容器实例, namespace, deployment, statefulset, pod, EIPPool, CCI负载, 无服务器容器, 创建容器实例, 删除容器实例, 容器状态, 容器日志
